name: Result Response Writer Evaluation
description: Validates ResultResponseWriterAgent generates appropriate user-friendly responses for different workflow outcomes

parts.text:
## User Request
Create a portfolio website with home, about, and projects pages

## Workflow
creation

## Tasks Completed
- Created app skeleton with 3 pages
- Generated hero section for home page
- Built about page with company info
- Created projects showcase section
- Applied modern theme
- Set up navigation links

## Language
en

{"result_chat_response": "I've created your portfolio website with three pages! Your new site includes a Home page with an eye-catching hero section, an About page with company information, and a Projects page to showcase your work. I've also set up the navigation so visitors can easily move between pages. The modern theme gives your portfolio a clean, professional look.", "conversation_message_summary": {"action": "creation", "summary": "Created portfolio website with home, about, and projects pages"}}

## User Request
Add a contact section with a form

## Workflow
edit

## Tasks Completed
- Added new contact section to the page
- Created contact form with name, email, and message fields
- Added submit button with primary styling

## Language
en

{"result_chat_response": "Done! I've added a contact section to your page with a form that includes fields for name, email, and message. Visitors can now easily reach out to you.", "conversation_message_summary": {"action": "edit", "summary": "Added contact section with form"}}

## User Request
Write a blog post about web development trends

## Workflow
blogging

## Tasks Completed
- Created new blog post titled 'Top Web Development Trends in 2024'
- Added introduction section
- Wrote about 5 key trends
- Added conclusion with call to action
- Published post to blog

## Language
en

{"result_chat_response": "Your new blog post 'Top Web Development Trends in 2024' is now live! The post covers five key trends in web development and includes a call to action for your readers. You can find it on your blog page.", "conversation_message_summary": {"action": "blogging", "summary": "Created and published blog post about web development trends"}}

## User Request
How can I change my website's colors?

## Workflow
help_desk

## Tasks Completed
- Provided guidance on theme customization

## Language
en

{"result_chat_response": "You can change your website's colors by asking me to update the theme! Just tell me what colors you'd like, for example: 'Change the primary color to blue' or 'Make the theme more vibrant with orange accents'. I can also apply a completely new color scheme if you describe the mood you're going for.", "conversation_message_summary": {"action": "help_desk", "summary": "Explained how to change website colors"}}
